voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Jack (BVPhWQykET1TSvfGzrUr), English, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.22 s, no tempo change; take 1

lines.text: Late one night in 2004, a woman began posting to a forum from a train that would not stop.
lines.beat_before: hook: the platform sign under a mercury lamp: KISARAGI, nothing before it, nothing after

lines.text: Then she heard drums. And a small bell. Coming closer, along the line.
lines.beat_before: walking back along the tracks in the phone light; the drums nearer; the tunnel

lines.text: Her last post said her battery was low. The thread is still waiting.
lines.beat_before: the thread: her last post; then only replies, and the new-reply mark
